definitions.gloss: final day of a performance run; closing day of a sumo tournament
definitions.explanation: The last day of a series of performances, exhibitions, or a sumo tournament. Originally a term from traditional performing arts, now widely used for any concluding event in a run.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{千秋楽|せんしゅうらく}だ。
⟦{大相撲|おおずもう}→大相撲：10113_oozumou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{千秋楽|せんしゅうらく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{優勝|ゆうしょう}→優勝：03647_yuushou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: The championship was decided on the final day of the grand sumo tournament.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧ミュージカル⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{千秋楽|せんしゅうらく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{観|み}ていない→観る：22793_miru⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。
examples.english: This musical reaches its final performance next Sunday, so if you haven't seen it yet, please hurry.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Originally from Buddhist gagaku music — the last piece played at a temple ceremony was called {千秋楽|せんしゅうらく} ("a thousand autumns of joy"). It was adopted into kabuki and other performing arts to refer to the final performance.

USAGE:
Commonly abbreviated to {楽日|らくび} or ⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧ in theater circles. Most widely associated with sumo and theater.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {千秋楽|せんしゅうらく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ (to reach the final day)
- {千秋楽|せんしゅうらく}⟦{公演|こうえん}→公演：11639_kouen⟧ (closing performance)
- ⟦{大相撲|おおずもう}→大相撲：10113_oozumou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{千秋楽|せんしゅうらく} (final day of a sumo tournament)
